definitions.explanation: The head of the Japanese government, officially known as the Prime Minister of Japan. Formally selected by the Diet and appointed by the Emperor.

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しい{総理大臣|そうりだいじん}が{決|き}まった。
examples.english: A new Prime Minister has been chosen.

examples.japanese: {総理大臣|そうりだいじん}が{記者会見|きしゃかいけん}を{開|ひら}いた。
examples.english: The Prime Minister held a press conference.

examples.japanese: {日本|にほん}の{総理大臣|そうりだいじん}は{国会|こっかい}の{議決|ぎけつ}で{指名|しめい}される。
examples.english: Japan's Prime Minister is nominated by a vote of the Diet.

notes:
USAGE:
The full formal title is {内閣総理大臣|ないかくそうりだいじん}. In everyday speech, {総理|そうり} alone is the most common short form. {首相|しゅしょう} is a near-synonym used more in news reporting.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {総理大臣|そうりだいじん}に{就任|しゅうにん}する (to take office as Prime Minister)
- {総理大臣|そうりだいじん}を{辞任|じにん}する (to resign as Prime Minister)
- {総理大臣|そうりだいじん}が{指名|しめい}される (to be nominated as Prime Minister)
